Privacy

Effective November 11, 2026 · Publisher: Brian Baker

This notice distinguishes the planned public version 1.0.0 from the separate TestFlight beta 0.1.1 (2). The public version is being prepared and is not yet available on the App Store. Live advertising is disabled in both versions. Only the TestFlight beta includes the optional test-ad preview described below.

Information on your device

Break My Build stores campaign progress, attempt counts, settings and a saved local remix on your device. The planned public version also stores earned Bolts, cosmetic ownership and selection, and local records used to prevent duplicate rewards and manage ad timing. These records remain local even though live ads are disabled. The app does not require a game account. It does not upload your puzzle layouts, shots or full play history to a game server. Local progress is not a promise of cloud backup or cross-device restoration.

Advertising and your choices

In the planned public version 1.0.0, live advertising is disabled. The game code does not start Google's advertising or consent checks, request ads, or show ad offers. This version does not include the Settings test-ad preview. Its advertising and consent libraries are included for future preparation; live advertising cannot be enabled remotely and would require a separately reviewed app update.

In the separate TestFlight beta 0.1.1 (2), open Settings → Test ads and choose to load a Google sample ad. Ordinary beta gameplay does not ask the advertising service to initialize or load ads. Test reward callbacks do not grant game currency. The beta checks Google's consent requirements before requesting a test ad; any required privacy choices must be completed first. The Ad privacy options control is available when Google's consent tools require it and may otherwise stay disabled. Non-personalized requests can still involve data processing. Refusing consent or an unavailable ad does not block campaign play or free retries.

Data processed by Google

Google's advertising services may process connection information such as IP addresses and derived approximate location, app or device identifiers, ad impressions and interactions, and diagnostic or performance information. These support advertising, measurement, fraud prevention and SDK operation. When starting the beta test-ad service, the app disables publisher first-party identifiers and requests that SDK crash reporting be disabled. These settings, and the public version's disabled ad-request flow, are not a guarantee that bundled libraries or operating-system services process no data. See Google's Privacy Policy and Google's advertising SDK data disclosures.

Device permissions

The current app does not request camera, microphone, contacts, GPS location or Apple's tracking permission. Apple's TestFlight services are governed by Apple's own terms and privacy information.

Support and this website

If you contact Brian Baker, the details you choose to send are used to investigate and respond to your request. Send only what is needed. This website has no advertising pixels, analytics scripts or account forms. Its hosting provider may process connection information to serve and protect the pages.

Retention and removal

Device-local progress remains until it is replaced or the app and its local data are removed. Deleting local game data does not delete records independently held by Apple, Google or your email provider. For support correspondence or a privacy request, contact the publisher below; do not send sensitive account credentials.

Audience

The publisher has selected a children or mixed-age audience. The ad request configuration applies child-directed and under-age treatment to every user, limits ad content to the general-audience rating, and requests non-personalized ads. The planned public version keeps live ads disabled and does not start that ad-request flow. Configuration alone does not establish actual device or provider behavior. Parents or guardians may contact the publisher with privacy concerns.

Contact and updates

Contact Brian Baker at relativityrush@gmail.com. Updates to this notice will identify their effective date and reflect the app's actual services.
